summary: The shared stylesheet for BOTH non-landing surfaces: docs.html (sidebar reference layout, body.docs-page) and every blog page (body.essay-page). The landing page uses styles.css instead, so .article-card on index.html is NOT styled here. The blog section at the end scopes its OWN theme tokens to body.essay-page: light by default with a prefers-color-scheme dark override, which is why docs.html stays dark while the blog follows the reader's OS. --measure MUST stay an absolute length (680px) and never ch: ch resolves against each element's own font-size, so a 46px h1 and a 19px p computed different widths and margin-inline:auto then centred every child of .essay-article on a different left edge (fixed in #105). Two widths govern essay layout and they differ on purpose: `.essay-article > *` constrains every child to --measure, while `.essay-article > .wide` opts out to min(920px,100%) — that 240px gap is why figures visibly overhang the prose column. The FIGURES block (added #111) styles inline-SVG diagrams: the hand-drawn look is a seeded feTurbulence displacement applied per figure, and the filtered <g> must contain ONLY shapes because displaced text is unreadable. It also overrides `.essay-article figcaption`, whose base rule sets font-family:var(--mono) and rendered diagram captions as code comments.
